title: Edit · verb
subtitle: 「編輯／修訂／修改／校對」，究竟是哪一種 edit？
description: 「編輯／修訂／修改／校對」，究竟是哪一種 edit？

words.meaning: 修訂；修改；重新整理內容
words.note: 使用者提供。revise 強調根據新想法、回饋或需要對文字、計劃、文章或文件作內容上的修改與改進。它比 proofread 更廣，可能涉及結構、論點、措辭和內容重寫。
words.example: She revised the report after receiving feedback.

exercises.original: Please edit the introduction so that the argument is clearer.

exercises.upgrade: revise · 修訂；修改；重新整理內容

options.explanation: 本題的決定性線索是 official removal of sensitive content before disclosure；這裡需要的是「遮蔽敏感資訊」，所以 redact 最精確。
常與 contract, bill, constitution, clause 等正式文件搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 official removal of sensitive content before disclosure；這裡需要的是「遮蔽敏感資訊」。因此 amend 雖與 edit 有關，但修改幅度、目的、出版階段或文件類型不如 redact 精確。

words.note: 較專業。copy-edit 指在出版前改善文字的一致性、清晰度、文法、拼字、標點和格式，通常比 proofreading 更深入，但比 substantive revision 更少改變內容。
words.example: The manuscript was copy-edited before typesetting.

exercises.original: The publisher edited the manuscript for style, consistency, grammar, and punctuation.
exercises.zh: 出版社就文體、一致性、文法和標點對手稿進行文字編修。

falseSynonyms.zh: revise 強調內容、結構或論點的修訂；edit 更廣，可包括校對、刪改、格式與出版處理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She revised the argument. She edited the manuscript.

falseSynonyms.zh: proofread 只做表面錯誤檢查；若要改結構或內容，就不只是 proofreading。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Please proofread the final copy. Please revise the introduction.

falseSynonyms.zh: rewrite 表示大幅重寫；普通 edit 可以只改幾個字。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The conclusion was rewritten completely. The editor changed two sentences.

falseSynonyms.zh: amend 多用於法律、政策、合約或正式條文；一般文章不一定用 amend。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Parliament amended the bill. She edited the article.

falseSynonyms.zh: correct 只表示把錯誤改對；edit 可以是風格、結構或內容優化，即使原文沒有「錯」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He corrected the wrong date. She edited the paragraph for clarity.

falseSynonyms.zh: redact 是為保密而刪除／遮蔽資料；普通 edit 不一定涉及敏感資訊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The names were redacted. The article was edited for length.

falseSynonyms.zh: copy-edit 是出版專業流程，通常處理清晰度、一致性、文法和 style；一般 edit 範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The manuscript was copy-edited before typesetting. The author edited the draft.

falseSynonyms.zh: edit 是動詞；editor 是名詞，指編輯人員或軟件編輯器。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She edits academic journals. She is an editor.
